in_sanskrit.name: उज्जवल
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: उज् (uj) + ज्वल (jval) = ujjval = glowing, radiant, brilliant

in_hindi.name: उज्जवल
in_hindi.meaning: उज् (uj) + ज्वल (jval) = ujjval = अगले प्रकाशक, अगले ज्वाला, अगले ताप, अगले सूरज (next light, next flame, next fire, next sun)
in_hindi.long_meaning: उज् (uj) = next, agle ज्वल (jval) = light, flame, fire, sun

in_tamil.name: உஜ்வல்
in_tamil.meaning: உள்ளம் உள்ளம் (ullamullam) = brilliance, splendor, radiance, luster, shine, lustre, light, brightness
in_tamil.long_meaning: உ (u) + ஜ் (j) + வ (v) + ல (l) = ujjval = brilliance, splendor, radiance, luster, shine, lustre, light, brightness

in_telugu.name: ఉజ్జ్వళ్
in_telugu.meaning: ఉదేశ, ఉద్యోదేశ (udhesha, udhyodesha) = desire, longing, aspiration, wish, motivation, inspiration, attraction, allure
in_telugu.long_meaning: ఉ (u) + జ్ (j) + జ్ళ (jval) = ujjval = desire, longing, aspiration, wish, motivation, inspiration, attraction, allure

in_marathi.name: Ujjaval
in_marathi.long_meaning: Ujjaval हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The one who is all-knowing, possessing extensive knowledge and wisdom.

in_bengali.name: Ujjaval
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Knowledge, Wisdom
in_bengali.long_meaning: Ujjaval একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। The one who is all-knowing, possessing extensive knowledge and wisdom.
